payload.title: Launch-state tiers generated from ladderStage + one Obelisk invite pipeline
contextHints: Founder instruction S294: showcase top launched projects, keep landing pages linking to beta or invite-only versions of the rest.

DEFECT: launch vocabulary is hand-written per page and unbound to the registry — /projects/vorn says early access, /projects/canon says invite, /projects/promogrind says beta.
Build a build-time generator: ladderStage -> badge + CTA + homepage tier. Launched(S1/S2)=full showcase. Beta(SB/S0)=join the beta. Invite-only(F2/F3)=request an invite. F0/F1/V*=not listed.

ONE invite pipeline behind Obelisk for every beta/invite-only project, not one per project. This dogfoods Obelisk on the highest-traffic surface the studio owns.

CANON-041 mobile parity and CANON-047 theme readability are blocking — the homepage is about to be the most-viewed page the studio has.

payload.headline: W265 The Local-Plane Pass — the session protocol prescribes control-plane commands to satellite repos, and nothing local proved they could run
payload.crossRepoRelevance: HIGH — the flagship finding affects EVERY satellite repo in the Studio, not just Obelisk.
findings: /start step 2.3 spells the D-S259.5 canon gate as `node scripts/start-canon-sync.mjs`, which resolves only inside Studio Ops. In any satellite repo it throws MODULE_NOT_FOUND, and the skill's own 'missing script -> note it, continue' rule then downgrades a MANDATORY gate to a silent note. SESSION_PROTOCOL.md:87 has carried the correct '../vaultspark-studio-ops/' form all along.
Cost measured, not hypothetical: run correctly the gate found Obelisk's canon TEN CANON entries behind (last sync 2026-08-16).

check-protocol-skill-parity.mjs passed throughout because it proves a gate's TEXT is PRESENT in each skill copy; build-skill-manifest.mjs hashes those files for drift. Neither ever resolves a command. A gate can be provably installed in six copies and dead in five.

Second instance the same session, on the audit path: SESSION_PROTOCOL 2B.5 names studio-oracle.mjs preverify for the MANDATORY premise-verification step, and that tool refuses by design in a project repo. Two independent instances on the two most-run paths is what makes this a class rather than a typo.
5 unrunnable commands found across 3 skills (studio-start, studio-closeout, whereami) — 2 more than the originating audit knew about.

Text-presence must never again read as coverage. Consider also forbidding the 'missing script -> note it, continue' downgrade for commands marked as GATES.
